bugs.summary: Login API returns 500 instead of 401 for invalid credentials
bugs.description:
Source: App VWO Login API doc + HLR (Login invalid credentials path).

POST /login with a wrong password should return 401/error status, but the service returns HTTP 500 with a generic server error, hiding the auth failure.

Steps to reproduce:
- POST https://app.vwo.com/login with {"username": "valid@user.com", "password": "wrong"}
- Observe HTTP 500 instead of 401

Expected:
- HTTP 401/4xx with a meaningful error message/code
- No session/token issued on failure

Acceptance Criteria:
- Invalid credentials return 401 (not 500)
- Error response contains a message/code
- No proxyToken/playerToken issued on failure
- Regression test added for the invalid-password path

bugs.summary: Session cookie not honored on subsequent authenticated API requests
bugs.description:
Source: App VWO Login API doc (session/token handling) + HLR verification dimension Cookie.

After a successful login, the session cookie set by the login response is not sent on subsequent API calls, so the user appears logged out on the next request.

Steps to reproduce:
- Login successfully and capture Set-Cookie
- Call an authenticated endpoint with the cookie
- Endpoint returns 401/session expired

Expected:
- Session cookie persists and is honored across requests
- Remember flag persists session when true

Acceptance Criteria:
- Cookie round-trip works for authenticated calls
- Token/session state consistent after refresh
- Test matrix (HLR Cookie dimension) covers this

bugs.summary: proxyToken and playerToken missing from login success response
bugs.description:
Source: App VWO Login API doc (Response - Validation: proxyToken, playerToken).

The login response contract requires proxyToken and playerToken on successful login, but the live response omits them, breaking clients that depend on the documented schema.

Steps to reproduce:
- POST /login with valid credentials
- Inspect response JSON for proxyToken/playerToken
- Fields are absent

Expected:
- Response matches documented JSON schema field-for-field
- proxyToken and playerToken present on successful login

Acceptance Criteria:
- Response schema validated against documented contract
- proxyToken and playerToken present
- Schema regression test added

bugs.summary: Duplicate registration email returns 200 instead of a conflict error
bugs.description:
Source: HLR (Registration section, duplicate email case).

Registering with an already-registered email should return an error/conflict status, but the API returns 200 with a success body, allowing duplicate accounts.

Steps to reproduce:
- Register a new email (201/success)
- Register the same email again
- Observe 200 instead of a conflict/4xx error

Expected:
- Duplicate/registered email returns an error
- No duplicate account created

Acceptance Criteria:
- Duplicate email rejected with meaningful status
- No duplicate account record created
- Regression test for duplicate email

bugs.summary: A/B test variations not distributed evenly under high traffic
bugs.description:
Source: PRD 4.1 Experimentation & Testing, FR1; traffic splitting for A/B campaigns.

Traffic split across A/B variations is heavily skewed under load (e.g. 80/20 instead of 50/50), producing biased experiment results.

Steps to reproduce:
- Create an A/B campaign with 2 variations (50/50 split)
- Drive high traffic through the experiment
- Observe variation distribution diverges from configured split

Expected:
- Traffic split deterministically and evenly per configured weights
- Results remain statistically valid

Acceptance Criteria:
- Distribution matches configured split within tolerance
- SmartStats conclusion is trustworthy
- Load test covers split accuracy

bugs.summary: SmartStats confidence metric incorrect for small sample sizes
bugs.description:
Source: PRD 4.1 SmartStats Bayesian engine; FR2 (Must); risk: data accuracy.

SmartStats reports high confidence (e.g. 99%) for variations with very small sample sizes, misleading users into declaring a winner prematurely.

Steps to reproduce:
- Run a campaign with low traffic (few conversions)
- Open the SmartStats report
- Observe overstated confidence/probability

Expected:
- Confidence metrics remain valid under low sample sizes
- Report explains actionable conclusion (winner / keep running / inconclusive)

Acceptance Criteria:
- Small-sample guardrails in place
- Confidence reflects uncertainty correctly
- Cross-tool validation matches

bugs.summary: Visual editor changes not reflected in live preview
bugs.description:
Source: PRD 4.1 Visual & Code Editor, FR3; version previews.

Edits made in the visual (WYSIWYG) editor do not appear in the live preview until a hard refresh, and sometimes not at all for CSS-only changes.

Steps to reproduce:
- Open an experiment in the visual editor
- Change an element's styling
- Open the preview
- Change is missing until full page reload

Expected:
- Changes preview before publish
- Editing workflows respond within 2 seconds (PRD NFR)

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editor changes render in preview immediately
- Preview reflects CSS/JS changes
- 2s editing workflow NFR maintained

bugs.summary: Heatmaps fail to render for pages behind login
bugs.description:
Source: PRD 4.2 Behavioral Insights (Heatmaps), FR4.

Click/scroll heatmaps do not render for pages that require authentication (login-protected pages), showing an empty canvas.

Steps to reproduce:
- Configure heatmap on a login-protected page
- View the heatmap in the Insights dashboard
- Canvas is blank / no data

Expected:
- Heatmaps generated for configured pages regardless of auth
- Data correlates with device/segment filters

Acceptance Criteria:
- Authenticated pages tracked and rendered
- Data attribution to segments works
- Regression test for auth-walled pages

bugs.summary: Session recordings stop after 30 seconds on long pages
bugs.description:
Source: PRD 4.2 Session recordings, FR4; retention policy (testingRetentionDays 90).

Session recordings truncate at ~30 seconds on pages with heavy DOM, losing the rest of the user session and hiding pain points.

Steps to reproduce:
- Enable session recording on a long/scroll-heavy page
- Let a user session run for 60+ seconds
- Play back the recording
- Playback ends at ~30s

Expected:
- Full session captured and playable
- Recordings filterable by segment/date

Acceptance Criteria:
- Recording length covers full session
- Playback reliable on heavy pages
- Retention policy respected

bugs.summary: Cross-browser QA: editor preview broken in Safari (layout shift)
bugs.description:
Source: PRD 4.1 cross-device/cross-browser QA; risk mitigation (SDKs + docs + templates).

Campaign version previews render with a layout shift in Safari (desktop) that does not occur in Chrome/Firefox/Edge.

Steps to reproduce:
- Open a campaign version preview in Safari (desktop)
- Compare with Chrome
- Observe content shift / misalignment

Expected:
- Cross-browser QA supported (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge)
- Version previews render consistently

Acceptance Criteria:
- Safari preview matches other browsers
- QA checklist integrated into campaign workflow
- Regression test in browser matrix
